title: Critical PHP vulnerabilities cause European website outages
excerpt: Two severe vulnerabilities found in the PHP programming language have triggered website outages across Europe and prompted a critical update.
body_html:
Multiple websites across Europe have experienced disruptions and outages following the discovery of two critical security flaws in PHP, a widely utilized programming language on the internet.

Authorities and maintainers have issued a critical cyber-security update to address the vulnerabilities. Administrators and website operators are advised to apply the patch promptly to secure their systems against potential exploits targeting these flaws.
